title: Anthropic’s 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO
lede: Anthropic's seven co-founders sold about $1.95 billion of stock in its IPO, roughly $280 million each at the raised $83 share price, before underwriting fees and taxes.

points: Each founder sold about 3.4 million shares; at the original $74 midpoint that would have come to around $250 million apiece.
The founders have pledged 80% of their equity to philanthropy, but the filing describes the pledges as voluntary, revocable and not legally binding.
Anthropic itself raised $104.8 billion, including $26 billion of non-voting Class N stock bought by Nvidia, Google, AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft and TSMC.
Google now holds 13.4% and Amazon 14.6%, together 28% of the company.
Anthropic discloses roughly $1.05 to $1.08 trillion in infrastructure commitments, $70.7 billion of it due within 12 months.

sections.text: The numbers show how compute-bound a frontier lab is: even after a record raise, its disclosed infrastructure commitments are about ten times the cash it took in, which shapes pricing and capacity for anyone building on its models.
